purpose: Teach: 講和/反米/布告/監禁/仮処分/歪曲/流布/招集

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、当事者間の講和的解決を警察、希望されてますね
lines.en: So the police are hoping the involved parties can reach a peaceful settlement, then?
lines.style: Careful, inquiring tone. Leaning slightly forward. Genuine curiosity about procedure—not challenging, just seeking confirmation. Even pace, slight upward lift at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、反米感情を悪用した詐欺事案にも警戒します
lines.en: Yes. We're also vigilant about fraud schemes that exploit anti-American sentiment.
lines.style: Measured, factual delivery. Professional distance. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. No emotion—just information conveyed with steady competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、容疑者に対し勾留を布告されますね
lines.en: And the police have issued a detention order for the suspect, correct?
lines.style: Confirming tone, but framed as question. Respectful of the officer's expertise. Deliberate pacing. Slight pause before the upward inflection.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不法監禁事件を全力で捜査します
lines.en: That's right. We're conducting a full investigation into the unlawful imprisonment case.
lines.style: Firm, resolute. Slight tap of conviction on 'full investigation.' Steady eye contact. Professional but not cold—the certainty of someone who means what they say.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、財産の仮処分を申請されてますね
lines.en: And provisional asset freezing measures have been filed as well, then?
lines.style: Polite inquiry with underlying sharpness. Careful enunciation. Pauses between clauses. Tone suggests he's piecing together a clear picture.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、事件の歪曲報道に厳重抗議します
lines.en: We're issuing a strong formal protest against distorted media coverage of the case.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Controlled intensity beneath the surface. Words chosen with precision. Not angry, but unmistakably serious about the distortion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、誤情報の流布元を特定されたんですね
lines.en: So you've identified the source of the misinformation, then?
lines.style: Impressed, slightly forward. Recognition that this is progress. Warm undertone—respecting the work. Natural conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、緊急時の応援招集も整備しております
lines.en: We've also mobilized emergency backup protocols to ensure rapid response when needed.
lines.style: Close, warm confidence. Like explaining something to someone he trusts. Direct eye contact. Reassuring without being patronizing. Calm, steady breath.
